thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: SEV-2 triggered for customer 'artemis' (tenant_id=artemis-prod). Symptom: tool/function-calling parser errors and increased 5xx responses from dedicated pool d-ed-3. Page sent to eng-oncall.
Kai Reyes: acked the page, jumping in. seeing spike in parser failures from vpc-proxy. request rate ~ 200/s, error rate ~ 18%.
Kai Reyes: impact: Artemis production (critical) experiencing failures on tool.call endpoints leading to customer retries and user-facing errors.
Anna Lopez: adding context — Artemis uses a custom tool schema with nested args array and JSONPath-based binding. We've deployed a parser rev last week (runtime parser v2.11) which might be stricter.
DevOps Sam: confirming routing — all Artemis traffic is pinned to dedicated pool d-ed-3 in us-east-1, route rule 'tenant-pin-artemis'.
Ryan Patel: logs showing parser errors: ``[2026-02-10T14:12:08Z] ERROR parse_toolcall: invalid_schema: missing field 'params' for toolId=invoker.send_email, tenant=artemis-prod``
Anna Lopez: here's a representative payload failing (copied from logs):
```
{
  "tool": "invoker.send_email",
  "args": {"to": "user@example.com"} // previously we had args as array: ["to","subject","body"]
}
```
Anna Lopez: looks like a schema drift: Artemis recently changed their client to send args as object; parser expects array. Our newer parser started enforcing schema instead of doing best-effort mapping.
Kai Reyes: immediate mitigation options: 1) enable legacy parser shim on d-ed-3, 2) route Artemis to fallback pool with old parser (d-ed-1), 3) push a quick tolerant parser patch.
Maria Chen: I'm on rotation, taking over once Kai summarizes actions. Kai please confirm current action plan.
Kai Reyes: Action taken: enabled temporary tolerance flag (--parser-best_effort=true) on d-ed-3 via /ops/flags API to allow object->array coercion. Rolling config applied to all nodes in pool (command pasted):
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/flags -d '{"pool":"d-ed-3","flag":"parser.best_effort","value":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx'
```
Kai Reyes: patch acceptance looks good: error rate dropped to ~3% within 90s. Customer side reporting some partial successes but still seeing rare edge cases. :thumbsup:
Artemis Support: we see a big drop. thanks. Will monitor for user complaints.
DevOps Sam: also started routing 10% of traffic to d-ed-1 (legacy-parser) as safety net. Canary configured: route rule updated at 14:16 UTC.
Ryan Patel: putting a small compatibility shim in the parser repo (pr #4321) that will coerce object args into array for known toolIds. Drafted patch, running unit tests.
Maria Chen: handoff: Kai — summarize what to look for and next steps for me.
Kai Reyes: Handoff summary:
- Root cause: schema drift from Artemis clients (args type changed).
- Immediate mitigation: parser.best_effort=true on d-ed-3, 10% fallback to d-ed-1.
- Short-term fix: compatibility shim PR #4321 being tested by Ryan.
- Customer comms: Artemis support informed and monitoring.
- Postmortem owner: Anna (will coordinate with Artemis eng).
Maria Chen: ack, taking oncall. I'll watch for regressions, confirm PR deploy, and prepare a rollback plan. If errors climb above 8% re-open page.
IncidentBot: Update: flag toggle recorded by Kai Reyes at 2026-02-10T14:14:03Z.
Ryan Patel: tests pass locally, pushing the shim to staging. CI run green. Deploy request sent: canary 1/5 nodes in staging.
Anna Lopez: contacting Artemis eng: "we saw parser errors, enabled best-effort mode temporarily. We'll deploy a compatibility shim in the next hour and follow up with a short maintenance window if needed."
Artemis Support: thanks, please also share any guidance so we can update client SDK.
Maria Chen: ordering patch rollout plan: canary to 10% of d-ed-3 tonight, monitor 30m, then 100% if stable. If any performance regressions, revert and fallback to d-ed-1.
DevOps Sam: creating a paging ticket for infra to monitor pool d-ed-3 resource utilization and tracer spikes.
Kai Reyes: leaving notes for post-incident: consider adding a runtime compatibility mode per-tenant and add schema-change webhook to notify customers when parser strictness increases.
Maria Chen: I'm going to escalate indicator to SRE channel if the error rate doesn't stay <5% in the next 20m.
Ryan Patel: shim deployed to staging canary. Requesting permission to promote to prod canary (Maria).
Maria Chen: promote to prod canary. Watch for error counts and p95 latency.
IncidentBot: prod canary deploy started by Ryan Patel at 2026-02-10T14:31:02Z.
Kai Reyes: quick note: telemetry shows slight p95 increase +30ms in the shim path — acceptable for now.
Maria Chen: p95 acceptable. error rate holding at 2.1% across pool.
Artemis Support: users report degraded email formatting in a handful of cases — likely mapping ambiguity. We're logging examples and will send later.
Anna Lopez: opened supportjira ART-1120 to track client SDK update and formatting regressions.
Maria Chen: final status for now: parser.best_effort=true; compatibility shim deployed as canary then rolled to pool; fallback routing in place. Customer impacted but degraded, majority traffic healthy. I'll keep monitoring and start a scheduled sync with Artemis for 16:00 UTC to coordinate SDK changes and a follow-up deploy.
Kai Reyes: leaving oncall — thanks team. Maria taking over.
Maria Chen: confirmed takeover. I'll coordinate postmortem and CC product/security as needed.
IncidentBot: Incident resolved to SEV-2 -> mitigation in place; monitoring in progress. Incident will remain open for postmortem.
Anna Lopez: action items recorded: 1) postmortem draft, 2) add schema-change webhook, 3) client SDK patch guidance, 4) add per-tenant parser toggle in console.
Maria Chen: thanks all. Closing the page for now but keeping thread pinned for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
